:::{#thm-edf-mean-variance}
#### Mean and variance in an exponential dispersion family

Let $Y$ have the density $f(y; \theta, \phi)$ of @def-exponential-dispersion-family,
and suppose that the support of $Y$ does not depend on $\theta$
and that $b$ is twice differentiable.
Then

$$
\ba
\E{Y} &= b'(\theta)
\\
\Varf{Y} &= \phi\, b''(\theta)
\ea
$$

[@dobson4e, Chapter 3; @dunn2018generalized, Chapter 5].
:::
